body:
During slow live collection, a25-product batch was exported, its30,465-record/6,921-blob public archive verified, and387/387 current prices matched original sources. The subsequent automatic checkpoint encountered another authorized staged code commit.

`publishCollectionCheckpoint` correctly refused to include unrelated staged files, but `collect-account-case.mjs` treated this temporary publication conflict as a fatal collection error and exited. No CAPTCHA or site error caused this stop. Collection was manually restarted using the same persistent profile and cached discovery.

Expected: preserve the existing index, defer only this checkpoint with a structured reason, continue slow collection, and retry publication at the next safe checkpoint. Actual commit/push failures and CAPTCHA stops must remain visible and must not be swallowed.

Baseline:6c63b8d. Reproduction: stage an unrelated code file in a temporary repository, then request an automatic public-case checkpoint. Regression coverage should verify no accidental commit, no modification of the existing staged code, safe collector continuation, and later publication after the index becomes available.
title: Defer automatic public checkpoints when unrelated changes are staged without stopping collection

An exact ProSupps selected source (SKU1553990700_VNAMZ-6552645102, original SHA25634f5fe968b4f857907fec4c0916a4bb2ca38cd6dfe99d1bb4d0ffa16b87f71a3) is titled Whey Isolate2lbs and selects Chocolate Ice Cream. title: Whey Chocolate Ice Cream flavour overrides powder category during original replay

body:
Generic Lazada product collection applied strict flavour rules to reports and SKU queues, but it did not select a compatible SKU before capture unless the URL explicitly named one. The observed Scitec listing pdp-i13427532777 offered Socola and Không Bình, yet recorded Zprotein Brownie5lbs with Bình Lắc at 3,070,000 VND. A corrected live selection confirmed Socola/Không Bình SKU 117192556069 at 3,540,000 VND on 2026-10-11.

Required behavior:
- Select a complete chocolate/no-shaker SKU combination on generic listings; retain exact requested sibling identity.
- Resolve dialogs first, pace each selection, animate into view, wait for SKU and price to settle, and reject a failed selection without recording a price.
- Reuse correctly selected captures; mark incompatible defaults for correction while preserving historical originals.
- Keep full observed variant inventory and nonmatching options for exclusion/review.
- Use the actual shipping destination in delivery quotes; a Hồ Chí Minh quote must never become Nha Trang delivered metrics.
- Preserve strict flavour and configured OCR during deferred recollection.

Local browser regressions and a slow live Scitec check are available under docs/acceptance/preferred-variant. This is a consumer selection/context defect in lazada-search; there is no evidence that Browser Commander selected the wrong SKU itself.
title: Select chocolate/no-shaker SKUs before capture and bind shipping to the actual destination

The parser treated this container packaging declaration as a headline and preferred the rounded4.5lb title, producing2041.165665g and489.91VND/g instead of seller-declared2040g and490.19VND/g.

Required behavior: recognize explicit package/container metric declarations as selling mass, preserve the original imperial claim, retain selected-size priority, reject serving/accessory/gift/shipping context, and leave conflicting distinct package masses under review. Factory2050g/formula identity remains unverified and is not approved by this seller correction.

The minimal general correction and source-hash/negative-context regressions are drafted in src/nutrition.js and tests/selected-package-mass.test.js;44 affected tests pass. Root is replaying cached observations and updating the public rankings with zero page downloads before pushing the correction.

Selected bulk offer SKU3255422832_VNAMZ-117013951240 says “2 túi tặng1 túi” (two bags, one gift bag). The current gram comparison uses only the two paid bags. The additional food gift is recorded but its exact net mass, same formula, unconditional availability and quantity rules are not yet source-confirmed.

Required acceptance: preserve paid and gift food separately, distinguish them from shaker/accessory gifts, bind each food gift to exact flavour/mass/formula and eligibility, and include its confirmed amount once in an eligible bulk basket denominator. Until those facts are confirmed, report the extra bag as conditional and do not silently count it or call the paid-bag denominator the complete offer. Public originals and all other selling options must remain reusable.

The source-bound current identity audit preserves this specific evidence gap under docs/acceptance/whey-current-identity/review.json. This issue remains open, linked to full basket/factory coverage in#3.
title: Verify and count food gifts in bulk selling options separately from accessory gifts

body:
Selected manufacturer names were ignored in a multi-product parent listing. SKU2019564464_VNAMZ-15735467762 selects IT'S JUST WHEY ISOLA / NATURAL, while the parent brand/title says Optimum Nutrition. The old candidate resolver returned only ON and could trust its domain for the selected different product.

Fix: retain the selected manufacturer lead, prioritize it, and flag all contradictory parent/selected candidates. Neither brand domain can establish an exact selected identity while the contradiction remains. A source-backed brand correction can resolve the conflict. Plain flavour labels without manufacturer names preserve the existing behavior.

The general resolver fix and targeted regression are implemented in src/manufacturers.js and tests/manufacturer-owned-brands.test.js. Fourteen owned-brand/worklist tests pass; complete exact package and nutrition proof remains in#3.
title: Selected SKU manufacturer conflicts are hidden by the parent listing brand

body:
Public manufacturer originals may contain access tokens unrelated to product evidence. Two Cremo HTML originals caused GitHub push protection to reject the publication; both contained an embedded public Mapbox token flagged as secret-style.

Acceptance: public originals and associative archive blobs redact both public and secret Mapbox token forms; preserve original SHA256, derivative SHA256, actual observation date and redaction receipt; imports bind the derivative bytes and retain original provenance. Keep product text, package facts and ownership links. Raw originals remain local. Never bypass push protection or hide the raw token in compressed archives.

Implemented in archive/source import, with three meaningful public-source regressions. All46 source/cache/archive focused tests pass. Complete manufacturer identity and delivery acceptance remains separate in#3.
title: Redact embedded manufacturer access tokens before committing original evidence

body:
Nutrition OCR loses decimal points in preserved exact original label images. For Häagen-Dazs source SHA256 `67907ce23aa9ff33a8431ad6ebe68289d842ab83f14586abf9d5ac7a5ab3c9e8`, original 4.0g and4.5g are transcribed as40g and45g in both tested PSM6 andPSM11. A high average confidence is insufficient to approve these numbers.

Reproducer and engine results: `docs/acceptance/manufacturer-research/second-ocr-pass.json`, `research-review.json`, and the preserved original label in the shared public archive. No new numeric facts from these passes were approved.

Acceptance: deterministic crop/preprocessing or reviewed transcription preserves original-image/transform/TSV provenance, cache keys include transformation and OCR settings, and an actual-label regression detects decimal loss. Every nutrient still requires exact flavour/market/package/formula identity and correct serving basis. Never infer a decimal solely from expected nutrition. A corrective source review must precede ranking. The root is continuing this investigation.
title: Nutrition label OCR drops decimal points despite high confidence

Required behavior: preserve all original observations and dates; select current product/offer state by observation time under the writer lock. Undated legacy imports remain supported but cannot overwrite a dated observation. Same-observation parser corrections remain allowed.

Implemented through `AssociativeStore.putLatest`, application `saveOffer`/`saveProduct`, and public capture publication. `tests/observation-order.test.js` covers price history, concurrent saves, older package evidence, same-date corrections and legacy imports.

Complete marketplace coverage and destination-specific bulk delivery remain tracked in #3.
title: Older cached observations overwrite newer SKU prices and package facts

body:
The collection queue stopped on listing13439335807 with `Page loading did not settle within30000ms: product title or price is still missing`.

The current original page has the explicit title `Xin lỗi! Sản phẩm này không còn tồn tại` (Sorry! This product no longer exists), no product title and no price. The classifier did not recognize this Vietnamese title; its generic readiness timeout stopped all remaining listings. No CAPTCHA stop was recorded.

Fixed in commit 547fdb2de5091640bd1b33e998d0257f392a7bbd: explicit Vietnamese/English removed notices classify as unavailable before product readiness. A priced product quoting a removed related product remains valid. CAPTCHA, login and app-only guards retain precedence; genuine loading/dialog failures remain blockers. Extractor version16 supports offline reclassification of existing HTML.

Validation:90 focused tests, four final classification cases, seven distinct local E2E cases across recorded runs. The browser regression captures the removed page, loads the next product successfully and then replays the unavailable-page cache without another request. The real page was recaptured and cached as unavailable with no fabricated price.

[Original sanitized HTML and observation](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/blob/547fdb2de5091640bd1b33e998d0257f392a7bbd/docs/acceptance/removed-product/README.md), [test receipts](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/blob/547fdb2de5091640bd1b33e998d0257f392a7bbd/docs/acceptance/removed-product/validation.json), [classification regressions](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/blob/547fdb2de5091640bd1b33e998d0257f392a7bbd/tests/removed-product.test.js), [browser regression](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/blob/547fdb2de5091640bd1b33e998d0257f392a7bbd/tests/e2e/page-loading.test.js). Full marketplace/factory/bulk/frozen coverage remains tracked in #3.
title: Removed Vietnamese product notice incorrectly stops the collection queue as a loading timeout

body:
Bulk chocolate ice-cream cartons can be parsed as `unknown` and use an inner-package amount as the selling-unit amount.

Reproduction: selected SKU `3040048563_VNAMZ-14623760583`, title `Thùng 24 chai kem choco Hàn Quốc Binggrae Pongta Chocolate 130ml ABetterLife`, selected price648,000VND. Original description explicitly says24 bottles/carton. Current automatic import produces category `unknown`,130ml and no packCount. Correct selling unit is24×130=3,120ml; the matched original factory wrapper prints131g per bottle, giving3,144g. Both unit-price results should equal a27,000VND single bottle.

An evidence-backed category/count correction is included in the committed expanded case, but a general library parser fix remains required. Frozen-destination availability is independent of stock: this exact page explicitly refuses Nha Trang delivery despite available stock.

Acceptance: CLI/library/Telegram handle carton titles and counts; original cached source replays offline; single and carton prices match independently; no duplicated carton multiplier; stock and destination refusal remain separate; no transfer of factory carton counts to a one-bottle offer.

Evidence: `docs/acceptance/ice-dual-units/expanded-root-pongta-carton.html.gz`, `root-expanded-review.json`, and `docs/tables/ice-source-expansion.md`.
title: Recognize ice-cream carton category and exact selling-unit package count

body:
When an archived review contains provenance metadata shaped as {sha256, bytes}, exportRepositoryArchive walks it as a stored blob reference, even if sha256 is the original pre-redaction capture digest and bytes is descriptive metadata. Export then fails with Missing source evidence although the sanitized original is present. Reproduced while archiving docs/acceptance/ice-dual-units/merino-review.json: historical capture digest a52e71d56692a8645ba5da09fe96a7f3914691930f3d9253f2abca83a71a1414 differs from sanitized artifact digest8089ed02a957b2864546069e248f0d1a97c1cb3d5dd01e5212fd70713a1c5c89.

Current producer workaround in scripts/archive-ice-research.mjs renames provenance metadata to contentSha256/byteLength while keeping original review JSON as a blob. Required general fix: distinguish typed stored-blob references from source-digest metadata, preserve source rewrite relationships, and add an archive round-trip regression. The workaround archive validates59records/58blobs with zero downloads.
title: Distinguish capture provenance metadata from stored blob references during archive export

The urgent original-source audit found that imperial headline parsing can override more precise metric selling-unit declarations. This affects per-gram comparisons.

Reproducible captured cases:
- Optimum Nutrition seller repack item3265021607 / SKU15762183506: title says2lbs and900gam; NetContent says2lbs(900g); description explicitly states a single900g zip bag repacked from a10lb parent bag. Raw parser reports907.18474g; selected unit is900g. Original private product source SHA f235ca5d2116d8aca18f0e5510a685e1e511c52c061aefe61a0af494bf359995; publicly redacted source SHA7020b63493f5878b2509f19fde2ca420521434f77776fd8bfeff0f6b17bb8ea3.
- ProSupps Chocolate Ice Cream powder item1553990700 / SKU6552645102: selected seller front prints907g; title2lb conversion produces907.18474g.
- Levels80-serving Vanilla item13451810835 / SKU117268785502: original selected bag prints2.56kg. Net mass was missing until the cached image was visually reviewed. It is sold out and outside the requested flavour scope, so excluded from buying ranks.

The committed case uses source-attributed field reviews and reproducible offline correction scripts; table calculations and source checks pass. General extraction still needs metric-priority and OCR package-matching regressions, handling seller repacks separately from factory and parent-package weights. Corrected fields must preserve original claims and trigger selective re-review when a genuine new selling unit is observed. See docs/acceptance/top10-check/ and scripts/review-handpicked-selling-mass.mjs. No fabricated manufacturer formula or density is approved.
title: Prefer selected metric selling-unit weights over imperial headline conversions

body:
The configured Vietnam protein category /protein/ currently redirects to the Lazada homepage. The collector correctly stopped with "Category scope mismatch at /" rather than treating the empty result as a completed category. Two ice-cream category scopes reached their displayed terminal page10, each showing386card observations, but that is not proof of all-market coverage.

Resolve the current exact category URL from Lazada navigation and verify every page, page identity and terminal control before the product-detail phase. Collect every relevant plain/unflavoured or chocolate powder SKU and strict chocolate-core ice-cream SKU, preserving all package quantities and selling options. Apply no minimum/maximum package-price filter. Search-card prices remain preliminary until the exact selected SKU, stock and manufacturer package have been matched.

Current independent gaps remain:221historical SKU prices, exact manufacturer/batch identity for newly discovered products, quantity-specific Nha Trang freight, frozen-delivery eligibility and discount applicability. These must remain explicit coverage gaps, not be assigned zero prices or assumed shipping. VBest's package and lab report disagree on protein(71.65% versus68.9%) and ingredient ratios, so the cheaper ratio must not silently win.

Evidence and published comparison tables live under docs/acceptance and docs/tables. Collection and corrections continue; this issue tracks missing coverage and does not claim a globally cheapest offer.
title: Protein category redirect and remaining SKU verification prevent complete bulk-buy coverage

body:
When a client cannot reach the loopback control endpoint, available() currently treats every connection error as an absent browser and launches another worker. If that second worker fails to launch, its shutdown() unconditionally removes browser-window.json belonging to the first live worker. The existing Chrome window remains open but loses its reusable authenticated control descriptor.

Reproduced with restricted loopback access: the second worker first failed with listen EPERM, then an unrestricted retry failed with Browser exited before its DevTools endpoint was ready(exit0). The original supervisor and Chrome process remained alive while the descriptor was gone.

Fix in progress: refuse replacement when the descriptor identifies a live but unreachable owner, only remove state owned by the terminating worker, and persist recovery metadata so a replacement supervisor can adopt the same owned Chrome window after an orphaned supervisor exits. Browser requests must retain their pacing history and the30-minute unused-window close rule. The live window was recovered without closing Chrome. No credentials, endpoints, tokens or account screenshots are published.
title: Failed persistent browser reconnect deletes another live worker descriptor

body:
The account workflow can stop immediately after a successful archive export and verification. A long-lived private store's shared RepositoryArchive fallback retains the old manifest and cached record indexes. Re-export replaces hashed shards and removes old filenames; the next audit tries to read a removed crawl shard and reports "Corrupt repository archive file" even though the new archive verifies successfully.

Reproduced on Node22.23.0: archive export and verification both passed with20635records/3749blobs, then the same workflow's audit attempted the removed records/crawl.78d68c51a348335d87bb224285ca835b278aff35f658d9a4ea76fe7278f1d3ef.json.gz.

Fix in progress: detect changed manifest generations, invalidate old record/index caches, and retry a read only when the generation actually changed. Real corruption must continue to fail. Regression must reuse the same private fallback across export and cover replacement during an active read. No account data is included in this report.
title: Account workflow retains stale archive shards after re-export
